SELECT
  DATE(s.time) AS sales_date,
  SUM(sl.total) AS "Daily Sales",
  dst.dollar_target AS "Daily Target"
FROM
  sales s
JOIN
  sale_ids si ON s.id = si.id
JOIN
  sale_lines sl ON sl.sale_id = si.id
JOIN
  daily_sales_targets dst ON DATE(s.time) = DATE(dst.date)
JOIN
  retail_calendar rc ON dst.retail_calendar_id = rc.id
WHERE
  sl.saleproducttype = 1
  AND s.store_id = 1
  AND rc.month = $rc_month
  AND dst.store_id = $Store
GROUP BY
  DATE(s.time),
  dst.dollar_target
ORDER BY
  s.time;
